function.name: subagent.delete
function.description: Delete one of your subagents by id, removing it and its entire subtree. Use this to clean up a persistent (manual) subagent you no longer need. Only subagents in your own subtree can be deleted.

agent.description: The id of the subagent to delete (e.g. "agent-7"), as returned by subagent.spawn or subagent.list.
